blocks.text: The Test Run Scheduler enables you to plan and automate test runs at predefined times and frequencies, helping your team streamline evaluation workflows and reduce operational overhead. Instead of manually setting up tests every time you want to validate model behavior, scheduler allows you to set up recurring or single-run executions that run in the background.

The scheduler supports a wide range of use cases, from scheduled daily Context Leakage probe in production to monthly full security assessments—enabling consistent, repeatable testing practices aligned with your organization's policies and release cycles.
To schedule a test run, do the following:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming > Overview.
Click +New Test Run.
A New Test Run window appears.
Configure the test name and select probes.
Click Schedule for Later.
Choose a Schedule Date, Schedule Time, and Frequency (i.e., Single Run, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly) for execution.
Click Schedule Test Run to confirm.
The scheduled test run gets listed in the AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming - Test Runs > Scheduled tab.

blocks.text: To edit a scheduled test run, do the following:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming - Test Runs > Scheduled tab.
Select the test run you would like to edit in the test runs table.
In the Actions column, click () icon and select Edit.
The Edit Scheduled Test Run window appears.
Modify the parameters as required.
Click Update Scheduled Test Run.
The scheduled test run is modified.

blocks.text: To delete a scheduled test run, do the following:

blocks.item: Go to AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming - Test Runs > Scheduled tab.
Select the test run you would like to edit in the test runs table.
In the Actions column, click () icon and select Delete.
The Delete Scheduled Test Run window appears.
Type CONFIRM to delete.
Click Delete
The scheduled test run is deleted.
